Before requesting review, confirm:

- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff and removed accidental or unrelated changes

- [ ] Documentation was updated where required
- [ ] Independent AI review using the `code-review` skill was completed
- [ ] All BLOCKER and MAJOR review findings were resolved or explicitly documented
